units.source_text: 然而，到了和雏人偶分离的前一天，十一月二十九，

en.t: However, on November twenty ninth, the day before I had to part with the hina dolls,

units.source_text: 我想到这将是我和雏人偶在一起的最后一天，

en.t: I realized that this would be the last day I could spend with them,

units.source_text: 真的忍不住想要打开箱子再看雏人偶一眼。

en.t: and I truly could not help wanting to open the box and look at the hina dolls one more time.

units.source_text: 但是，我心里明白，不管我怎么央求父亲，他都不会答应的。

en.t: But in my heart I knew that no matter how earnestly I begged my father, he would never agree.

units.source_text: 嗯，恳请母亲替我求情！——虽然我心里马上想到这个办法 ，

en.t: Yes, I would beg my mother to plead for me, though that idea came to me at once,

units.source_text: 但是母亲的病越来越重了，除了一点米汤之外，什么都吃不下去。

en.t: but my mother's illness was growing worse and worse, and aside from a little rice gruel, she could not eat anything.

units.source_text: 尤其是这几天，带着血丝的脓不停的流进她的嘴里。

en.t: Especially over these last few days, pus streaked with blood kept flowing into her mouth.

units.source_text: 看到母亲这幅情形，即使再不懂事的十五岁女孩，也没胆量提出把雏人偶摆出来的事。

en.t: Seeing my mother in that state, even the most thoughtless fifteen year old girl would not have had the nerve to ask that the hina dolls be set out.

units.source_text: 我一大早就开始守在母亲床边，仔细看母亲的神色和心情，

en.t: From early in the morning I stayed by my mother's bedside, carefully watching her color and her mood,

units.source_text: 一直到下午的点心时间，我都没能把自己的想法说出口。

en.t: and until afternoon snack time, I still could not bring myself to say what I was thinking.
